capabilities: Carry the previous review's plan into the next trading day
Browse a trading-day calendar with section completion indicators
Search and filter past reviews by date, month, text or section
Generate optional AI daily and weekly analysis
disambiguation: Not a trading bot or brokerage tool; it only records and reviews trading decisions in Markdown notes.
extras: Basic journaling needs no AI account; AI analysis sends review text to the configured provider and credentials are stored in data.json. Built-in Chinese stock-market holidays for 2024–2026, with annual updates fetched from the Shanghai Stock Exchange.
problem: Traders have no structured place in Obsidian to record daily market observations, check earlier plans and review decisions over time.
summary: Local-first trading journal that keeps daily and weekly trade reviews in Markdown notes, with a trading-day calendar and optional AI analysis.
